composers_checked.name: Mendelssohn, Felix
composers_checked.note: Gap check against English Wikipedia's list and IMSLP's category: the Concert Pieces Op. 113 and 114 (clarinet, basset horn, piano) have no string part; Variations concertantes Op. 17 is a duo; the string symphonies and the Serenade and Allegro giocoso are for string or full orchestra. Not added: the Trio for piano, violin and viola in C minor (1820, MWV Q 3) and the 17 fugues for string quartet (MWV R 1-17), which are not on IMSLP and for which only an arrangement of the trio (Trio Zadig, 2025) turned up. Piano Quartet in D minor (MWV Q 10): Quartetto Klimt (Brilliant, 2020), medium confidence.

composers_checked.name: Schumann, Robert
composers_checked.note: Gap check against English Wikipedia's list and IMSLP's category: the duos (Op. 70, 73, 94, 102, 113) are out; Op. 56 trio arrangements are not by Schumann. Only WoO 32 (Piano Quartet in C minor, 1829, Previn/Kim/Ohyama, Sony 1992) is missing from IMSLP and added. Op. 46 is kept in its original five-player scoring (WoO 10).

composers_checked.name: Paganini, Niccolò
composers_checked.note: Gap check against English Wikipedia's list, IMSLP's category and the discs: the 15 guitar quartets are all recorded (Dynamic/Paganini Ensemble Vienna Vols. 1-4, 2021-24; Paganini Quartet, Dynamic 1994; Brilliant 96872, 2023; Ambitus 2001); IMSLP lacks Guitar Quartet No. 10 (MS 37) and String Quartet No. 1, both added. Keys follow IMSLP and Dynamic: Brilliant's page prints No. 4 as A major. The violin-and-guitar duos and guitar solos are out of scope.

composers_checked.name: Raff, Joachim
composers_checked.note: Floor from Apple Music track lists: Tudor/Società del Quartetto di Milano (Nos. 1, 7), cpo/Mannheimer Streichquartett (Nos. 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8), MDG/Leipziger Streichquartett (No. 5; Octet; Fantasie Op. 207b), cpo/Trio Opus 8 (piano trios), Divox/Ensemble Il Trittico (Piano Quintet; Piano Quartets). Gap check against English Wikipedia's list: Op. 207b added; Op. 77b-192b are arrangements; the Sinfonietta Op. 188 has no strings; WoO 9 and WoO 13 were destroyed. Apple Music labels Quartet No. 5 as C major and Quartet No. 7 as E-flat (Vol. 2); IMSLP and Wikipedia say G major and D major, which the titles follow.

composers_checked.name: Bazzini, Antonio
composers_checked.note: All six quartets are recorded: Quartetto d'Archi di Venezia (Dynamic, 2000) and Quartetto Bazzini (Tactus: Nos. 1 and 3, 2018; Nos. 2, 4 and 5, 2022). Years: composition where a source gives it (English Wikipedia for Nos. 4 and 5), else first print. Gap check against English Wikipedia's list: nothing missing.

composers_checked.name: Ernst, Heinrich Wilhelm
composers_checked.note: Quartet Op. 26 is recorded by the Ciompi Quartet (Toccata Classics, 2013). The showpieces with quartet accompaniment (Op. 6, 17, 18) are on disc in their violin-and-piano versions only. Gap check against IMSLP's category (32 pages): the other pages are for violin solo, violin and piano or orchestra; the out-of-scope Fantaisie brillante Op. 11 is not added (no recording of a quartet version found).

composers_checked.name: Mayer, Emilie
composers_checked.note: Floor: Constanze Quartet Vols. 1-2 (2023, 2026), Amai Quartet (2025), Erato Quartet (cpo 2000), Trio Vivente (cpo 2017), Retrenchment Trio (2024), Mariani Klavierquartett (2021) from Apple Music track lists; the A-minor, D-minor and E-flat trios only from the MusicBrainz release "Missing Link" (Klaviertrio Hannover, Genuin, 2022; timings from the MusicBrainz recordings), so medium confidence. Gap check against English Wikipedia's list: the String Quartet and Piano Quartet in G major are added; the quartets in B-flat and other keys on Wikipedia's list have no recording found (not all checked). Years are mostly unknown, so left blank.

composers_checked.name: Molique, Bernhard
composers_checked.note: Floor from Apple Music track lists: the Mannheimer Streichquartett's cpo cycle (Vol. 1 2005, Op. 18 No. 3 and Op. 28 2009, Vol. 3 2011, Opp. 42 and 44 2016) covers Opp. 16-18, 28, 42, 44. Gap check against English Wikipedia's list: Quartets Opp. 16 and 17 are not on IMSLP and are added; the Piano Quartet Op. 71 (E-flat) is not on IMSLP and a search for it on Apple Music returned nothing (weak: no second source). The Wikipedia list has no other chamber work for 3+ players.

composers_checked.name: Weber, Carl Maria von
composers_checked.note: Gap check against English Wikipedia's list: the other chamber works are duos (Grand Duo concertant, Op. 48; Silvana variations) or for guitar and piano. IMSLP's Serenade, J. 65 is not a chamber piece.

composers_checked.name: Hensel, Fanny
composers_checked.note: Gap check against English Wikipedia and IMSLP: Op. 11 (benchmark), the Piano Quartet and the String Quartet are her only chamber works for 3+ players; the cello sonata is a duo.

composers_checked.name: Schumann, Clara
composers_checked.note: Her only chamber work for 3+ players is the Piano Trio (benchmark 100084); her violin pieces are duos.

note: Early Apple and MusicBrainz lookups ran before the shared fetcher existed; every one that was blocked (403/503) was redone through it or replaced by a web search. Evidence is mostly Apple Music track lists (album ids in sources), the Dynamic, Brilliant and Ambitus pages for Paganini, IMSLP and Wikipedia work lists. Open points: (1) Mayer's A-minor, D-minor and E-flat piano trios rest on MusicBrainz alone (release 'Missing Link', Klaviertrio Hannover, Genuin, 2022; not found on Apple Music). (2) Paganini keys follow IMSLP and Dynamic; Brilliant prints No. 4 as A major, and Dynamic 1994 lists all three string quartets under MS 20, so no MS numbers are given for them. (3) The Paganini Guitar Quartets Nos. 6, 8, 11, 12 and 13 have no timing found (minutes null). (4) Ernst's showpieces with quartet accompaniment (Op. 6, 17, 18) are skipped because only the violin-and-piano versions are recorded; the owner may want them if a quartet-version performance turns up. (5) Schumann's Andante and Variations is kept in its original scoring for two pianos, two cellos and horn (WoO 10), titled Op. 46 as the recordings do. (6) Not fully checked: Molique's Piano Quartet Op. 71 (nothing on Apple Music, no second source) and Mayer's remaining manuscript quartets. (7) Levels of the lesser-known composers (Raff, Bazzini, Mayer, Molique, Ernst) are estimates from the genre and the benchmarks, without scores; phase 4 should regrade them. (8) Raff's Fantasie Op. 207b is added from Wikipedia's list and two recordings; I could not confirm whether the IMSLP page 'Phantasie, Op.207' holds the quintet score. No benchmark issues found.
